items.fromString:
Our Marvell CI is https://jenkins-csb-nst-net-hw-ci.dno.corp.redhat.com/view/DPU%20Testing/job/99_E2E_Marvell_DPU_Deploy/

In CASC, we `export SKIP_NF_TESTING=true`, which causes the CI run to skip some tests from `e2e-test/e2e-test.go`.

Those tests would not pass, because in dpu-operator we hard code `EXTERNAL_CLIENT_DEV=eno12409`, which is not suitable on the system where our Marvell CI runs (on wsfd-advnetlab44.anl.eng.bos2.dc.redhat.com this interface is called `eno2`)

Fix that somehow.

See also: https://github.com/openshift/dpu-operator/pull/611

items.fromString:
Cluster 17 (wsfd-advnetlab225) and Cluster 18 (wsfd-advnetlab226) were not used for a while. Only their worker nodes (wsfd-advnetlab42 and wsfs-advnetlab43) were lent out to kernel QA for verifiying bugs (they installed RHEL there, etc).

Right now, Cluster 17's wsfd-advnetlab42 is borrowed to qren (who want to reprovision the host using beaker, which does not work out of the box with our worker nodes, so she probably have to make some changes to the bios settings (boot order). We will need to check what to do, when taking that machine back).

Anyway. So I wanted to reprovision cluster 18 (simply run `task e2e-test`). But that simply didn't work. It seems as if the switch configuration changed(???). I kinda gave up on that, but at the same time, we anyway want to setup the one-cluster switch configuration as is on cluster 19 (with 4x25Gb ports from the QSFP fanout/breakout, as described in [https://github.com/wizhaoredhat/marvell-octeon-10-tools/blob/main/docs/howto_ethernet.md]).

For that, we currently have ticket [https://redhat.service-now.com/help?id=rh_ticket&table=sc_req_item&sys_id=61d514c03b60f250fdf1bd8c24e45a2c] to do that change.

Once that ticket was updated, we should to to cluster 18 and try to re-provision it (and later cluster 17, after qren is done using the machine).

Reprovision it means primarily run `task e2e-test` and see that it succeeds. We want that our old two-cluster setup (`task e2e-test`) can still be used with the new cluster layout. Optimally, it will just work. If it does not work, try to fix marvell-octeon-10-tools to make the two-cluster setup in the new switch-layout work automatically – all the while cluster 15 still runs CI for the two-cluster setup with the old switch-layout.

Basically, we need that `task e2e-test` can work out-of-the-box to create the old two-cluster setup with both old and new switch layout.

Additionally, with the new switch layout it should be possible to use those clusters out-of-the-box to create the new one-cluster setup (as is configured on cluster 19).

 

DoD:

 
 - cluster 18 has a similar network layout (with the 4x25GB QSFP ports). This requires switch configuration (See lab ticket) and the BIOS settings (see howto_ethernet)
 - on these clusters it should be possible to run our venerable `task e2e-test` to create the two-cluster setup (like CI does currently on cluster 16). This should not require manual tweaking.
 - it should be possible to do the once-cluster setup. For that, first deploy a OCP cluster (for example, via CDA and [https://github.com/openshift/dpu-operator/blob/main/hack/cluster-configs/config-dpu-host.yaml]). Then follow [https://github.com/wizhaoredhat/marvell-octeon-10-tools/tree/main?tab=readme-ov-file#add-marvell-dpu-as-openshift-node-running-red-hat-coreos]
 - finally, the one-cluster setup should easily work with the opidemo.sh script from [https://github.com/thom311/opi-poc/commits/th/single-cluster-demo/] . That script will need some adjustment (IP addresses), but that should be easy to get working.

Cluster 17 (wsfd-advnetlab225) and Cluster 18 (wsfd-advnetlab226) were not used for a while. Only their worker nodes (wsfd-advnetlab42 and wsfs-advnetlab43) were lent out to kernel QA for verifiying bugs (they installed RHEL there, etc).

Right now, Cluster 17's wsfd-advnetlab42 is borrowed to qren (who want to reprovision the host using beaker, which does not work out of the box with our worker nodes, so she probably have to make some changes to the bios settings (boot order). We will need to check what to do, when taking that machine back).

Anyway. So I wanted to reprovision cluster 18 (simply run `task e2e-test`). But that simply didn't work. It seems as if the switch configuration changed(???). I kinda gave up on that, but at the same time, we anyway want to setup the one-cluster switch configuration as is on cluster 19 (with 4x25Gb ports from the QSFP fanout/breakout, as described in [https://github.com/wizhaoredhat/marvell-octeon-10-tools/blob/main/docs/howto_ethernet.md]).

For that, we currently have ticket [https://redhat.service-now.com/help?id=rh_ticket&table=sc_req_item&sys_id=61d514c03b60f250fdf1bd8c24e45a2c] to do that change.

Once that ticket was updated, we should to to cluster 18 and try to re-provision it (and later cluster 17, after qren is done using the machine).

Reprovision it means primarily run `task e2e-test` and see that it succeeds. We want that our old two-cluster setup (`task e2e-test`) can still be used with the new cluster layout. Optimally, it will just work. If it does not work, try to fix marvell-octeon-10-tools to make the two-cluster setup in the new switch-layout work automatically – all the while cluster 15 still runs CI for the two-cluster setup with the old switch-layout.

Basically, we need that `task e2e-test` can work out-of-the-box to create the old two-cluster setup with both old and new switch layout.

Additionally, with the new switch layout it should be possible to use those clusters out-of-the-box to create the new one-cluster setup (as is configured on cluster 19).

 

Here are some notes from the original story that might get lost otherwise:
 - cluster 18 has a similar network layout (with the 4x25GB QSFP ports). This requires switch configuration (See lab ticket) and the BIOS settings (see howto_ethernet)
 - on these clusters it should be possible to run our venerable `task e2e-test` to create the two-cluster setup (like CI does currently on cluster 16). This should not require manual tweaking.
 - it should be possible to do the once-cluster setup. For that, first deploy a OCP cluster (for example, via CDA and [https://github.com/openshift/dpu-operator/blob/main/hack/cluster-configs/config-dpu-host.yaml]). Then follow [https://github.com/wizhaoredhat/marvell-octeon-10-tools/tree/main?tab=readme-ov-file#add-marvell-dpu-as-openshift-node-running-red-hat-coreos]
 - finally, the one-cluster setup should easily work with the opidemo.sh script from [https://github.com/thom311/opi-poc/commits/th/single-cluster-demo/] . That script will need some adjustment (IP addresses), but that should be easy to get working.
 - 
the new switch layout involves:
 - all ports of the cluster are on the same switch (sw05). This makes it easier to flexibly reassign VLANs, also because the apply-vlan.sh script cannot handle VLAN configuration across switches (which should be fixed).

 - DPU should be configured to have 4 port with 25Gb/s, using QSFP and fanout/breakout connections.

Basically, see what cluster 19 does (except on cluster 19 not all ports are currently connected to sw05)

 

DOD: Deploy marvell cluster in any shape

Once that ticket was updated, we should to to cluster 18 and try to re-provision it (and later cluster 17, after qren is done using the machine).

Reprovision it means primarily run `task e2e-test` and see that it succeeds. We want that our old two-cluster setup (`task e2e-test`) can still be used with the new cluster layout. Optimally, it will just work. If it does not work, try to fix marvell-octeon-10-tools to make the two-cluster setup in the new switch-layout work automatically – all the while cluster 15 still runs CI for the two-cluster setup with the old switch-layout.

Basically, we need that `task e2e-test` can work out-of-the-box to create the old two-cluster setup with both old and new switch layout.

Additionally, with the new switch layout it should be possible to use those clusters out-of-the-box to create the new one-cluster setup (as is configured on cluster 19).

 

DoD:

 
 - cluster 18 has a similar network layout (with the 4x25GB QSFP ports). This requires switch configuration (See lab ticket) and the BIOS settings (see howto_ethernet)
 - on these clusters it should be possible to run our venerable `task e2e-test` to create the two-cluster setup (like CI does currently on cluster 16). This should not require manual tweaking.
 - it should be possible to do the once-cluster setup. For that, first deploy a OCP cluster (for example, via CDA and [https://github.com/openshift/dpu-operator/blob/main/hack/cluster-configs/config-dpu-host.yaml]). Then follow [https://github.com/wizhaoredhat/marvell-octeon-10-tools/tree/main?tab=readme-ov-file#add-marvell-dpu-as-openshift-node-running-red-hat-coreos]
 - finally, the one-cluster setup should easily work with the opidemo.sh script from [https://github.com/thom311/opi-poc/commits/th/single-cluster-demo/] . That script will need some adjustment (IP addresses), but that should be easy to get working.
